name: TVS Motor Company Limited
summary: TVS Motor Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive vehicles and components, spare parts, and accessories in India, Brazil, and internationally. The company operates through Automotive Vehicles & Parts and Related Investments; and Investment Held in Financial Services segments. The company offers motorcycles under the Apache RTR, Apache RR, Ronin, Raider, Radeon, StaR City+, HLX, and Sport brand names; scooters under the Jupiter, Neo, Ntorq, and Zest brands; electric vehicles under the TVS X, Orbiter, and iQUBE brands; mopeds under the XL 100 brand name; and three wheelers under the TVS King brand name.
